SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 3.5.1 Structure of a paragraph, part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to organise the ideas in your paragraphs coherently? 2. How can you ensure that your paragraphs are well formed?
